memories.content: Marguerite is the owner of the Copper Kettle bistro. She typically replies to most reviews within days, and her replies tend to be defensive. She has just become aware of a one-star review posted last night complaining about a 45-minute wait on a night the bistro was short two servers.

A one-star review of the Copper Kettle bistro was posted on a major review site last night. The review mentions a 45-minute wait and that the bistro was short two servers that night. The review site allows business owners to post public replies to reviews.
